Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Feedback and Recommendation Letter to Hotel Manager
Nội dung chi tiết:
You recently stayed at the Grand Horizon Hotel during a vacation with your family. While you generally enjoyed your stay, there were a few issues that needed improvement. Write a formal email to the hotel general manager to provide your feedback.

In your email, you should:
- Mention the details of your stay (dates, room number) and express your overall impression
- Detail specific problems you encountered (e.g., room service delays or noise at night)
- Recommend constructive suggestions to improve customer experience in the future

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Pursuing a Career as a Sales Manager
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In recent years, an increasing number of young graduates in developed countries like the United States prefer pursuing a career as a sales manager over other traditional professions. While this job offers high income potential and rapid career advancement, it also brings immense work pressure and irregular working hours."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of choosing a career as a sales manager. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.2: Informal Letter Advising a Friend on Organizing a Community Event in the Countryside
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your close friend, Alex, who is planning a community sports and cultural festival in his home village. Read part of his email below:

"Our village youth committee has decided to organize a community weekend festival next month to bring neighbors together. Since you have experience in organizing events, could you give me some suggestions on suitable activities we should include, how to attract local villagers, and what potential logistical issues we need to prepare for?"

Write an informal email responding to Alex.

"I am so sorry that I cannot pick you up at the airport because my university exam schedule was suddenly moved! Could you catch the express train into the city center? Also, if you have free time in the evening, is there any special place or nightlife activity you would love to experience?"

Write an informal email responding to Lauren.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.3: Fast Fashion: Root Causes and Environmental Solutions
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"The global fashion industry has witnessed the rapid expansion of 'fast fashion'—mass-producing cheap, low-quality garments to meet fleeting trends. However, this model now accounts for approximately 10% of total global carbon emissions and generates massive amounts of textile waste."

Write an essay to an educated reader analyzing the root causes of the fast fashion phenomenon and proposing viable solutions to mitigate its severe environmental damage. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
